```
export PATH="/c/Program Files/nodejs:$PATH"
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
```
`npm` is NOT on PATH by default in this shell — the export above is required or prisma's preinstall script fails with "'node' is not recognized". Confirm success with `ls node_modules/.bin/tsc node_modules/.bin/vitest`.

DELIVERABLE: `database/029_courses.sql` plus a commit.

=== WHY ===
Exams are the top-level entity; there is no grouping above them. An instructor runs several differently-natured subjects in one term, so exam-level settings cannot be shared or separated per subject. This migration introduces that grouping. It must be additive and reversible: existing exams keep working with no course.

=== SCHEMA ===
`public.courses`:
- `id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()`
- `instructor_id text NOT NULL` (single-owner; do NOT add a membership table)
- `name text NOT NULL`
- `term text` (nullable, free text such as `2026-1`; do NOT model this as year+semester enums — seasonal and irregular terms break that immediately)
- `created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`
- `updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`

`public.exams`: add `course_id uuid REFERENCES public.courses(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`. It MUST be nullable.

Indexes: `courses(instructor_id)` and `exams(course_id)`. Nothing else.
Do NOT add a unique constraint on `(instructor_id, name, term)` — re-offering the same course name must stay legal.

=== CONVENTIONS (copy from `database/018_onboarding_activation.sql`) ===
`BEGIN;` ... `COMMIT;`; every statement `IF NOT EXISTS`; `ALTER TABLE public.courses ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;`; `REVOKE ALL ON public.courses FROM anon, authenticated;`; a service_role-only `FOR ALL` policy created after `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS`; `GRANT ALL ON public.courses TO service_role;`; a commented-out rollback block at the end.

=== HARD PROHIBITIONS ===
- Do NOT backfill existing exams. No `UPDATE` statement anywhere.
- Do NOT make `course_id` NOT NULL.
- Do NOT create a membership/co-ownership table.
- Do NOT run the migration. No database connection of any kind — no `psql`, no `supabase` CLI, no `prisma migrate`. Hard project stop-rule.
- Do NOT read any `.env*` file.
- Do NOT touch any file other than the new migration.

=== VERIFY (paste real output for each) ===
1. `ls database/ | grep -E '^[0-9]{3}_' | sort | tail -4` — confirm 029 is free and 028 is the current max
2. `grep -c 'IF NOT EXISTS' database/029_courses.sql`
3. `grep -nE '^\s*(UPDATE|DELETE|DROP)' database/029_courses.sql` — MUST print nothing
4. `grep -n 'course_id' database/029_courses.sql` — show it is nullable (no NOT NULL on that column)
5. `grep -c 'service_role' database/029_courses.sql` — expect at least 2
6. `git status --short`

=== MANUAL-QA (required; data-shaped change) ===
`cat database/029_courses.sql` and paste the COMPLETE file. Grep counts are not proof the DDL is correct.

Declare not-applicable with one line each: malformed input, prompt injection, cancel/resume, dirty worktree, hung commands, flaky tests, repeated interruptions.

=== COMMIT ===
Stage ONLY `database/029_courses.sql`. Never `git add -A`, never `git add .`.
Message exactly: `feat(platform): courses 테이블과 exams.course_id 추가`
No `Co-Authored-By`. Do NOT push.
